name: Time-Varying Volume Compression Strategies
definition: Compression approaches for real-time rendering of time-varying volumetric datasets, designed to overcome bandwidth limitations and enable interactive loading/decoding/rendering.
summary: Time-Varying Volume Compression Strategies address real-time rendering bandwidth limits by exploiting temporal coherence across frames, distinguishing themselves from static methods through techniques like 4D extension, key-frame encoding, or per-step compression.
